verdict.rationale: Rainforest supports event-driven automation via webhooks that notify platforms on resource status changes, and it documents a no-code Zapier integration for building automated workflows off those events. This covers basic event-trigger automation but lacks any first-party rule-definition engine, conditional logic, or AI-native rule authoring — missing for 10: native rules/conditions engine, AI-driven trigger definitions, and independent evidence of Zapier automations in practice.
